notes.title: Updates To April Grove
notes.content:
[h3]We've Heard Your Feedback and Added More![/h3][p]
Thank you for all of your support in these first weeks after April Grove's release! We've been chopping away at all of the issues and concerns that the community has brought to us, and added a few other extras ourselves. You may not have noticed each of the changes in the little patches we posted along the way, but here is the full log of the changes and fixes we've knocked out!
[/p][hr][/hr][h3] 
Updates and New Features:[/h3][list][*][p]Added auto save option (default is off for existing players)[/p][/*][*][p]Some characters are trying their hand at camping[/p][/*][*][p]More thanks for your efforts in the postal service[/p][/*][*][p]Something new is under construction[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tease to the north and south[/p][/*][*][p]Robin now provides rental equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Added the library we forgot (oops)[/p][/*][*][p]New songs for Robin and more[/p][/*][*][p]Lost our last shred of dignity[/p][/*][*][p]More text for all characters[/p][/*][*][p]Mason's welcome booklet[/p][/*][*][p]You can pet the chicken[/p][/*][*][p]Added 1 new necklace[/p][/*][*][p]Added pristine trees[/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 new axes[/p][/*][*][p]Exp bar animates[/p][/*][*][p]Added exp drops
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]
Fixes and Patches:[/h3][list][*][p]Daisy will no trap you in the corner behind the sign and hold you hostage[/p][/*][*][p]Daisy will no longer have her clothes disappear on exiting her burrow[/p][/*][*][p]Saving and quiting no longer stores position (it wasnt supposed to)[/p][/*][*][p]Loading into the game should now always place you at your bed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed exp bar animation issue when gaining <1% of needed exp[/p][/*][*][p]The fire axe no longer skips the checks for pristines[/p][/*][*][p]Improved layering in several places[/p][/*][*][p]Relocated some tree placements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all known tiling errors[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed known bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed glitter tree bug[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: We Are Sprucing Up April Grove!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8YHIc2uo3B4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]April Grove is quite the sappling of a project![/h3]

⸻

[b]Here's what you already know - you:[/b]
[list]
[*] play as a novice forester (either a boy or a girl)
[*] live and work in a peaceful, danger-free forest
[*] earn experience as you get better at your job
[*] buy equipment and items that speed up your work
[/list]
⸻

Sounds fun, right? But surely there could be more... Maybe something to spruce up your journey to woodcutting dominance, chopping away in a quiet forest? Well, how about time changes, weather will changes, and the all kinds of new tracks to match!

When you feel like taking a break from chopping down trees, why not talk to some of the new townsfolk? They could give you a new look, a helping hand, or one or two of them might even need your help sooner or later!

⸻

In the meantime give April Grove a wishlist to stay up to date and check out our other games on Steam and our socials below!
